thread:
sandra (support): Morning — AtlasQ (kl-440) reports rising 5xxs on their dedicated instance around 09:14 UTC. Webhooks failing and a spike in UI errors. Marking P0.
incident-bot: Pager: INC-4721 triggered for high 5xx rate on /v1/deployments/kl-440. Oncall: mike. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated-5xx
mike (oncall): Ack. Checking pools — dedicated pool 'kl-440-pool' shows request queue growth and GPU util ~95% on node set A.
julian (eng-incident-lead): Noted. Traffic pattern looks like aggressive client retries from kl-440/payments. Might be a retry-loop after an upstream timeout. Could be exponential backoff absent.
sandra (support): Customer on call now. They want ETA and mitigation steps we can recommend externally. Also asked for a short status snippet for their Ops.
anna (account-rep): On the call — they need a gentle rollback option but prefer not to change client code during business hours.
mike (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) apply per-account rate-limit caps; 2) enable standby routing to shared-hosted endpoint as fallback; 3) increase ingress queue capacity while we assess.
incident-bot: Action: rate-limit rule applied by mike at 09:18:42 UTC. Autoscaler launched lane-standby at 09:19:10 UTC.
sandra (support): Draft to AtlasQ (please edit): ```Hi AtlasQ — we're investigating elevated errors and delayed webhook delivery for your dedicated instance (kl-440). We've applied temporary rate limits to reduce retry amplification and are routing traffic to a standby lane to restore delivery. Expected stabilization within ~20 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem and remediation suggestions. - Redwood Inference Ops``` :thumbsup:
julian (eng-incident-lead): Looks good. Add: "If you prefer immediate continuity we can route you to your shared-hosted endpoint; differences in latency/throughput may apply." Also capture which subaccounts affected: kl-440/main, kl-440/pay, kl-440-embeds.
anna (account-rep): Customer accepted standby routing and asked for a status page blurb and a tailored incident subject line.
sandra (support): Status page blurb suggestion: "Partial degradation impacting AtlasQ (kl-440) dedicated instance — some webhook deliveries and UI operations failing. Mitigations in progress." Any objections?
mike (oncall): No objections. Monitoring shows 5xx rate down 65% and webhook retries falling. Keeping throttles for 30m.
julian (eng-incident-lead): Capture artifacts: heap and request-queue snapshots saved to /artifacts/incidents/INC-4721. Next: replay client pattern in staging, prepare code-side retry guidance, and schedule postmortem owner (sandra).
sandra (support): I'll own the postmortem and the customer-facing RCA. Handoff: mike will be oncall for another 12m before rotating. If regression, escalate to julian immediately.
incident-bot: Pager closed at 09:36:00 UTC by mike. Thread will remain for RFC and customer comms.
sandra (support): Sent email + portal update to AtlasQ. They requested an annotated timeline for their audit — adding to postmortem scope. Closing thread for paging but keeping notes here. :white_check_mark:
